answer: In a decentralized AI economy, a Sybil resistance mechanism such as Byzantine Fault Tolerance (BFT) can be employed to prevent fake-identity attacks. This mechanism works by establishing a trusted harbor where agents can securely share and verify information, creating an oasis of trust within the network. As agents attempt to whisper false information to gain an advantage, the BFT protocol detects and rejects such attempts, ensuring the integrity of the network and protecting against Sybil attacks.
